exposure: maternal high BMI-related polymetabolic risk scores
outcome: Child gestational age and weight at birth
Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: Two cohorts of mother-child dyads: 425 in the discovery cohort and 489 in the replication cohort
finding: Maternal BMI-defined metabolome, particularly polymetabolic risk scores (PMRSs) based on inflammatory and glycolysis-related measures, predicted pregnancy complications, birth outcomes, and neurodevelopment in children better than anthropometric BMI alone.
mod_finding: PMRSs predicted Cesarean section delivery better than anthropometric BMI.
